findings: For spectralDNS U_hat storage (3,n,n,n//2+1) with even n, the only stored kz planes whose negative-kz partner is also stored are kz=0 and kz=n/2. Full in-storage Hermitian validation therefore checks U(-kx,-ky,kz)=conj(U(kx,ky,kz)) on both planes; inventing an interior-kz pair check is incorrect.
The existing host harness validates an initial zero-plane symmetry condition but does not emit per-step/final checks on both r2c boundary planes.

Kinetic energy should be recorded from the host real velocity after get_velocity at every trajectory step: E=0.5*mean(sum_i U_i^2). This avoids silently assuming a shenfun Fourier normalization. A spectral Parseval cross-check may be added only with an explicitly pinned transform convention.

For zero Source, record a nonincrease diagnostic as a bounded numerical check with declared tolerance. For nonzero/static/dynamic Source, monotonic decay is not a valid generic gate because forcing can inject energy; record the series and, if desired, a separately defined work balance.

Timestep refinement must compare the same final time and identical frozen initial/source data. At minimum record endpoint velocity and modified-pressure differences for dt=0.002 vs dt=0.001; do not infer an order from only two levels.

initial_and_each_completed_RK_step: run hermitian_boundary_report(c.U_hat) before any claim of trajectory conjugacy
persist step index, physical time, Source class (zero/static/dynamic), exact support/fallback mode, and diagnostic pass/failure
final_state: repeat Hermitian and energy diagnostics after final readout
compare dense-vs-hybrid velocity_hat, rhs/pressure outputs already required by host harness
for refinement pairs, compare identical final-time endpoints
native_host_integration_contract.failure_policy: Any boundary-plane conjugacy failure is a verification failure. Energy increase is a failure only for a declared zero-Source dissipative check; forced cases are recorded, not monotonic-gated.

remaining_obligations: Execute verifier-owned diagnostics on the pinned native spectralDNS/shenfun/FFTW host.
Run zero/static/dynamic Source trajectories as previously frozen.
Run same-final-time dt=0.002 and dt=0.001 refinement on one sparse-preserving and one densifying case.
Retain dense-vs-hybrid full trajectory and cost evidence; no PDE or universal speedup claim.
